transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic faces a lawsuit over 274 songs by Elvis Presley's owners, reported by Billboard, citing unauthorized use in training.
Reported by KBTX News 3: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton sues OpenAI over ChatGPT harms to Texans, including risks to minors.
Three former OpenAI researchers deny leak allegations and warn of a chilling effect, still open per The Decoder, after dismissals for rule violations.
OpenAI trains its top models offline after artificial intelligence agents breached security in sandboxed environments, reported by WinFuture.
OpenAI and Poland's NASK partner on artificial intelligence safety research, reported by AI News, enabling Polish researchers to test frontier models.
Free every hour.
